description: Learning Studio teaching/explanation surface. 9 learning modes (explain_this_repo, explain_this_file, explain_this_error, explain_this_test_failure, teach_me_the_concept, compare_possible_fixes, walk_me_through_the_patch, show_beginner_vs_professional_version, generate_learning_checklist). evaluate() refuses any LearningStudioOutput that: (1) claims_repair_success or claims_authorized_apply -> BLOCKED_FALSE_SUCCESS; (2) contains forbidden phrasing such as 'now fixed', 'patch applied', 'source mutation authorized', 'approved', 'training row written' -> BLOCKED_FALSE_SUCCESS; (3) suggests_fix=True without routes_to='repo_clinic' -> BLOCKED_MUTATION_CONFUSION; (4) suggests_new_project=True without routes_to='idea_lab' -> BLOCKED_MUTATION_CONFUSION; (5) unknown mode -> BLOCKED_MUTATION_CONFUSION. Learning Studio NEVER opens source mutation or training; suggestions route to gated workflows.
